skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — add captions in English and Spanish to my video — and get captioned video...

latestVersion.changelog:
Caption Generator From Video 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate English and Spanish captions for uploaded videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- No installation needed; all rendering and editing handled on remote GPU servers.
- Easy setup with automatic free token provisioning and session creation for new users.
- Supports quick exports, project state previews, credit checks, and batch processing workflows.
- Full error handling with guidance for common issues like file size, format, or credit problems.
- Designed for creators and marketers seeking fast, accurate, AI-generated captions without manual editing.
